text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER -> prod-cluster-2: gpu memory paging + elevated 5xx on /generate. Alert group: GPU_PAGING_HIGH. Started 2026-03-17T13:10:52Z. Link: https://alerts.internal/3401239876

micah: oncall here, ack. I see runtime OOMs in the runtime pods (lr-runtime-2). Pulling canary and routing traffic to spare pool. Reducing max_batch_size to 4 on the serving layer now.

tara: thanks. I'm pulling NVML traces + dmesg from g-12 and starting a pmap snapshot. Leaving marker at 13:12:30 UTC.

micah: started rollback of model rollout (v2-quant -> v2-fp16) at 13:13:05 UTC. Canary evicted from serving pool.

ops-bot: artifacts upload: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3401239876/logs.tar.gz (nvml.log, pmap_snapshots/, kvcache_stats.json, batch_metrics.log) :white_check_mark:

sam: customer impact: error rate peaked at 2.3% for API key tier "standard" between 13:12 and 13:22 UTC. Latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 830ms. Notifying CS to throttle webhooks.

micah: quick triage notes:
- observed repeated "CUDA out of memory" traces from lr-runtime PID 4210.
- GPU mem histogram shows growing transient allocations during attention pass.
- KV cache size increased ~2.6x on serving nodes with long conversation sessions.

tara: pasting nvml excerpt for context:
```
2026-03-17T13:12:11Z GPU0 mem_used: 15004 MiB mem_total: 16384 MiB free: 1380 MiB
2026-03-17T13:12:13Z GPU0 mem_used: 15678 MiB free: 706 MiB
2026-03-17T13:12:16Z GPU0 mem_used: 16290 MiB free: 94 MiB
2026-03-17T13:12:18Z lr-runtime[4210] CUDA OOM at attention.cu:142
```

micah: kvcache_stats.json summary (top-level): hit_rate 0.72, avg_kv_size_per_session 18.2MB, 95p_kv_sessions 63MB. Fragmentation hint: small free slabs scattered, compaction not triggered.

sam: timeline so far:
- 13:10:52 alert fired (GPU_PAGING_HIGH)
- 13:11:15 oncall paging alert escalated
- 13:12:05 v2-quant rollout started (automated canary)
- 13:12:30 nvml shows growing mem allocations
- 13:13:05 rollback initiated -> v2-fp16
- 13:15:20 traffic routed to spare pool
- 13:21:00 error rate trending down

micah: hypotheses (ranked):
1) v2-quant has attention fusion codepath that does larger temporary allocations per-token; combined with long kv cache leads to transient OOMs and GPU slab fragmentation.
2) KV cache growth pattern is not evenly releasing slabs; allocation churn + small fragmentation causes page walks under pressure.
3) Batching behavior with high concurrency created allocation storms (large effective batch together with long sequences).

tara: things we tried live:
- reduce max_batch_size from 16 -> 4 (immediate CPU->GPU pressure drop)
- disabled auto-prefetch for KV cache on canary nodes
- rolled back quantized model to fp16
All three correlated with drop in OOMs.

micah: short-term mitigation tasks (assigned):
- micah: keep roll back active and monitor for 30m (checking p95 & OOM logs).
- tara: run memory compaction sweep job on spare pool nodes and collect slab histograms (ETA 20m).
- sam: scope customer impact report and notify account teams.

ops-bot: logfile snippet uploaded: /pastes/3401239876/oom-stack.txt

tara: manual compaction ran at 13:24:40 UTC, slab histogram before/after:
```
BEFORE: free_slabs_small: 127, free_slabs_large: 4, fragmentation_score: 0.62
AFTER: free_slabs_small: 21, free_slabs_large: 18, fragmentation_score: 0.21
```

micah: good signal. After compaction and rollback, GPU mem used stabilized around 9.6GB and no new OOMs in last 18m.

sam: adding hypothesis-tracking note: tagging this thread with "hypothesis:quant-memory-surge" and "mitigation:rollback+compaction". Will add links to artifacts in the incident ticket (INC-3401239876).

micah: next steps for RCA: deeper kernel trace for attention path, reproduce locally with v2-quant on smaller card, instrument allocator metrics per-slab, and add a safety cap for kvcache growth per-session.

tara: I'm exporting a reduced repro using a long-chat sequence + v2-quant run on a dev-gpu; pushing to buildkite job 7862.

micah: handing over to @sam for stitching timeline and starting RCA doc. Leaving note: oncall remains until 14:05 UTC then handoff to next.

sam: ack, taking over. I'll collect all artifacts and open an RCA doc with timeline, logs, and postmortem action items.

micah: thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring for 1h.
